name: mw-listed-share-withholding
description: Malawi listed-share disposal withholding research for the intended 2026 period. Use this partial Guide for a broker or dealer paying a seller, to classify the payment, test the two express exemptions, compute the cited proceeds-based withholding and distinguish final withholding from an ordinary capital-gain calculation. It covers income-tax-exempt sellers and immediate reinvestment in other listed shares without inventing a reinvestment window or partial-relief formula. Two executable cases compare proceeds with a supplied gain and an exempt payment with an ordinary payment. Commencement, the historical exemption paragraph mismatch, broker definitions, current return procedures and the tax treatment after an exemption remain unresolved. This draft is a conditional source-text workpaper, not approval for a live disposal or filing.
